about: A view is the place's own: a published lock takes a view line that names leaves only when one of them is a leaf of the place, and a line that names none where its view names this place or no place at all.

So a place is published with each of its views once, with the leaf it writes, and never with a view another place's lock spoke. A place that is also a capsule keeps its own views: a capsule's own lock declares regions and never a view.
